lines.text: Aniimo launches: the America server opens Sep 15 at 10pm EDT on PC and consoles, with mobile following Sep 23
BlizzCon reveals: WoW: Forever beta runs Sep 17 - Oct 21 ahead of its Nov 4 launch, and Eclipse will close out Midnight
Winds of Mysterious Fortune (through Sep 22) pays 500 Trader's Tender for logging in on five days
October's Pokemon GO headliners are confirmed: Gigantamax Cinderace Max Battle Day Oct 3, Zorua Community Day Oct 10, Hatch Day Oct 17

needs_you.action: Aniimo's America server opens tonight at 10:00 p.m. EDT: log in with the exact email you used in the betas (not a Google sign-in), or link it before creating a character, to keep your test rewards and Bond Pact eggs
Attended BlizzCon in person? Link your BlizzCon Pass to Battle.net by Sep 18 or the in-game rewards will not be delivered
The $4.99 Staraptor Super Mega Raid Day ticket is only sold until Sep 19 at 5pm local, and its bonuses only apply during the 2-5pm event
Log in on five separate days before Winds of Mysterious Fortune ends with the Sep 22 realm restarts to collect 500 Trader's Tender
Rank up the Horizons Celebration GO Pass before it closes Sep 22 at 8pm local, then claim its rewards by Sep 24 at 8pm
Finish the $1.99 Phantump Catch Mastery paid Timed Research by 8pm local the same day, or its rewards are lost

Watch up to 12 hours of eligible WoW Twitch streams before Sep 27 at 10:00 a.m. PDT for the BlizzCon drops (including the Fluffy Comfy Flying Quilt mount), and log in once by Sep 27 for the BlizzCon Door Mat decor
Buy the World of Warcraft BlizzCon Bundle before the individual BlizzCon bundles leave the Battle.net Shop Sep 28
Finish the September Traveler's Log for the Crested Ember Leafmimic mount and spend or freeze Trader's Tender before the Trading Post rotates Sep 30
Claim every LEGO Stores reward, including the stamp rally Pikachu and avatar jacket, by Sep 30 at 11:59pm local
The $4.99 Gigantamax Cinderace Max Battle Day ticket is only sold until Oct 3 at 5pm local, and its Timed Research must be finished during the 2-5pm event
Finish the Harvest Festival branching apple research by Oct 5 at 8pm local, and claim its GO Pass rewards by Oct 7 at 8pm
Rank up GO Pass: September before rank earning stops Oct 6 at 10am local, using the uncapped GO Points on Oct 3 and 4; rewards expire Oct 8
Redeem the Chansey Plant code P0K0P1AGARDENS at a Pokemon Center PC before it stops working Oct 7
Evolve Zorua by 9pm local on Community Day for Zoroark's exclusive Charged Attack; the $1.99 Special Research is only worth buying before the 2-5pm event
Hatch with the GO Pass Deluxe: September Timed Incubator before it expires Oct 13 at 10am local

games.typical_lead_time: in-game calendar visible 4+ weeks out; shop and patch news 1-2 weeks

timeline.title: Curse of Ula'tek
timeline.detail: The Coiled Isle is open with the Vaults of Atal'Utek, Curse Surges and Cursed Fishing, the Altar of Fangs dungeon, three new Delves, the Tidebound Grotto Lair, Housing Blueprints and four new neighborhood Endeavors.

timeline.title: Midnight Season 2 and the Venomous Abyss
timeline.detail: Season 2 continues with the eight-boss Venomous Abyss plus Mythic+, PvP Season 2 and Bountiful Delves; all four Raid Finder wings are now open.

timeline.title: Winds of Mysterious Fortune
timeline.detail: Log in on any five days before the event ends with the Sep 22 realm restarts to earn 500 Trader's Tender, with a 20% experience and 50% reputation buff and Mysterious Satchel drops for characters below level 90.

timeline.title: BlizzCon viewership drops
timeline.detail: Watch eligible WoW streams on Twitch for 2, 4, 8 and 12 hours before Sep 27 at 10:00 a.m. PDT for 200 Trader's Tender, the Cuddly Blue Grrgle decor, the Fluffy Comfy Flying Quilt mount and a banner toy; logging in any day through Sep 27 also earns the BlizzCon 2026 Door Mat decor.

timeline.title: Trading Post: friendship in September
timeline.detail: September's rotation offers the Crested Ember Leafmimic mount as the Traveler's Log reward, plus special Outlet vendors with discounted and returning items; spend or freeze Tender by Sep 30.

timeline.title: WoW BlizzCon 2026 Bundle
timeline.detail: Buy the bundle (Rabbit'ath flying mount, Ensemble: Garb of the Dawnfire Phoenix, Perch of the Dawnfire Phoenix housing decor) on the Battle.net Shop by Sep 28, when the individual BlizzCon bundles leave the shop.

timeline.title: Vibrant Petalweave Collection
timeline.detail: Four floral transmog ensembles (Sunlit, Blush, Azure, Scarlet) are in the in-game Shop and on Battle.net, sold as a bundle or individually, with the price adjusting for pieces you already own.

timeline.title: Cataclysm Timewalking
timeline.detail: The Cataclysm dungeon rotation returns Sep 15 with its own weekly quest and Timewarped vendor.

timeline.title: WoW: Forever beta
timeline.detail: Beta access opens Sep 17 with the pre-purchased Skyborne Epic Pack or Warcraft Forever Collection, ahead of the Nov 4 global launch at 3:00 p.m. PST; the limited Collection bundle is sold through Jan 11, 2027.

timeline.title: Pirates' Day (micro-holiday)
timeline.detail: Talk to the Dread Captain in Booty Bay for the one-day pirate costume buff and its achievement.

timeline.title: Brewfest
timeline.detail: Brewfest opens Sep 20 outside Ironforge and Orgrimmar with daily Coren Direbrew runs, Brewfest Prize Tokens, and the ram and kodo mounts.

timeline.title: Harvest Festival
timeline.detail: Honor Uther and Grom at their memorials for the week-long Harvest Festival quest and its bounty of food.

timeline.title: Darkmoon Faire (October)
timeline.detail: The Faire reopens Oct 3 for its usual week of tickets, profession quests and carousel buffs.

timeline.title: Mists of Pandaria Timewalking
timeline.detail: The Mists of Pandaria dungeon rotation runs Oct 6-13 with six Timewalking instances, the weekly quest and the Timewarped vendor.

timeline.title: The Great Gnomeregan Run (micro-holiday)
timeline.detail: Race a level-1 gnome from Gnomeregan to Booty Bay in the annual weekend fun run.

timeline.title: Hallow's End
timeline.detail: Hallow's End begins at the window's edge with daily Headless Horseman runs for his mount, candy buckets across Azeroth, and the Tricky Treat vendors.

timeline.title: Midnight 12.1.5: The Promise of Tomorrow
timeline.detail: The next content update, on the PTR with no release date announced, concludes the Quel'thalas saga with the one-boss Unbinding of Kith'ix raid, Labyrinths, hourly Aqir Invasions and Ascendant Venomstones.
timeline.estimate_basis: On the PTR; Blizzard has not announced a release date

weekly_rhythm: Week of Sep 15 (now): Cataclysm Timewalking; PvP Brawl: Classic Ashran; WoW: Forever beta and the BlizzCon live Q&A on Sep 17; Pirates' Day Sep 19; Brewfest opens Sep 20

Week of Sep 22: Arena Skirmish Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Packed House; Winds of Mysterious Fortune ends at the Sep 22 restarts; Harvest Festival through Sep 28; Twitch drops close Sep 27 and BlizzCon bundles leave the shop Sep 28
Week of Sep 29: World Quest Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Deep Six; the Trading Post rolls over Sep 30
Week of Oct 6: Mists of Pandaria Timewalking; PvP Brawl: Arathi Blizzard; Brewfest ends Oct 6; Darkmoon Faire through Oct 10; Gnomeregan Run Oct 10-12
Week of Oct 13: Battleground and Pet Battle Bonus Events; PvP Brawl: Gravity Lapse; Hallow's End begins Oct 19
Week of Oct 20 (window end): Delves Bonus Event and PvP Brawl: Deepwind Dunk begin at reset; a Talebound preview is expected on the PTR in October
just_past_window: Oct 20-27: Delves Bonus Event and PvP Brawl: Deepwind Dunk
Oct 21: WoW: Forever beta ends; Invite-A-Friend launch codes start emailing Oct 20
Oct 27 - Nov 3: Timewalking Dungeon Event, PvP Brawl: Shado-Pan Showdown, and WoW: Forever Early Name Reservation ahead of the Nov 4 launch

games.typical_lead_time: events usually announced 1-4 weeks ahead; season schedule posted at season start

timeline.title: Season 24: Twilight Trails
timeline.detail: The season runs to Dec 1 with more Paldea debuts including Maschiff and Mabosstiff, Mega Evolution debuts for Staraptor and Chandelure, and Dynamax Rhyhorn, Sneasel and Sizzlipede in Max Battles.

timeline.title: GO Pass: September
timeline.detail: Rank toward a Latios encounter; Deluxe is $7.99 or $9.99 with 10 ranks, GO Points are uncapped Oct 3-4, rank earning ends Oct 6 at 10am local, rewards expire Oct 8 at 10am, and the Rank 20 Timed Incubator expires Oct 13.

timeline.title: GO Battle League: Twilight Trails
timeline.detail: Mega-Evolved Pokemon are eligible in the new Mega Editions of all three leagues this season, with a free Timed Research Pass, Ryme-inspired avatar items and a guaranteed Pikachu Libre rank-up encounter.

timeline.title: LEGO Stores and Pokemon GO
timeline.detail: Participating US LEGO Stores host boosted Pikachu raids, a stamp rally leading to Special Background Pikachu, a LEGO-branded avatar jacket via Timed Research, and a SMART Play demo; everything must be claimed by Sep 30 at 11:59pm local.

timeline.title: Pokemon Horizons Celebration
timeline.detail: Charmander wearing Friede's goggles debuts (evolvable to Charizard in goggles), Pikachu in Cap's hat returns to one-star raids, day and night wild spawns rotate, and an event GO Pass ($4.99 Deluxe) runs to Sep 22 at 8pm local, rewards claimable through Sep 24.

timeline.title: Staraptor Super Mega Raid Day
timeline.detail: Mega Staraptor debuts in Super Mega Raids with Super Max unlockable and boosted Shiny odds; up to six free Raid Passes from Gym spins, a $4.99 ticket (sold until 5pm local) for up to 14, and the remote raid limit rises to 20 from Sep 18 at 5pm to Sep 19 at 8pm PDT.

timeline.title: Choose Your Path: Twilight Trails
timeline.detail: Pick one of three Timed Research paths, Explore, Catch or Battle, to shape your tasks and bonuses for the week; the research runs Sep 23 at 10am to Sep 28 at 8pm local.

timeline.title: Phantump Catch Mastery
timeline.detail: Throw-accuracy Field Research and free Timed Research bring boosted Shiny Phantump with 2x XP and extra Candy for Nice throws or better; $1.99 paid Timed Research adds more Phantump and must be finished by 8pm local that day.

timeline.title: Harvest Festival: Applin Picking
timeline.detail: Shiny Applin debuts, Mossy Lures dispense Tart, Sweet and Syrupy Apples, and a branching apple Timed Research plus an event GO Pass ($4.99 Deluxe) run to Oct 5 at 8pm local, with pass rewards claimable through Oct 7.

timeline.title: Harvest Festival: Taken Over
timeline.detail: Team GO Rocket floods PokeStops and balloons from Oct 2 at 12:00am to Oct 5 at 8pm local; chase Giovanni with the GO Pass Super Rocket Radar to save Shadow Zekrom, hatch the debuting Shiny Shroodle, and TM away Frustration.

timeline.title: Gigantamax Cinderace Max Battle Day
timeline.detail: Gigantamax Cinderace fills six-star Max Battles with Shiny Gigantamax Cinderace debuting; all Power Spots host Gigantamax Battles with 8x Max Particles, a $4.99 ticket (sold until 5pm local) adds Timed Research and 2x Max Battle XP, and the remote raid limit rises to 20 from Oct 2 at 5pm to Oct 3 at 8pm PDT.

timeline.title: Zorua Community Day
timeline.detail: Zorua swarms with boosted Shiny odds and Special Backgrounds from 2pm to 5pm local; evolve to Zoroark by 9pm for its exclusive Charged Attack, with a $1.99 Special Research and Zorua on regular Lures until 9pm.

timeline.title: Hatch Day
timeline.detail: A Hatch Day runs Oct 17 from 11am to 5pm local; the featured hatching Pokemon has not been announced yet.

weekly_rhythm: Spotlight Hour is Thursdays 6-7pm local; Raid Hour is Wednesdays 6-7pm local; Max Monday runs 6am-9pm local
Spotlight Hours: Charmander wearing Friede's goggles Sep 17; Rattata Sep 24; October's lineup is not announced yet
Max Mondays: Articuno, Zapdos and Moltres Sep 21; Sobble Sep 28; October is not announced yet
5-star raids: Zamazenta Sep 16-22; Xurkitree, Pheromosa and Buzzwole Sep 23-29; Xerneas Sep 30 - Oct 6; the rotation after Oct 6 is not announced yet
Raid Hours: Zamazenta Sep 16; the Ultra Beast trio Sep 23; Xerneas Sep 30
Mega Raids: Venusaur Sep 16-22; Malamar Sep 23-29; Victreebel Sep 30 - Oct 6; Shadow Thundurus (Incarnate Forme) in weekend Shadow Raids through Oct 6
GO Battle League: Willpower Cup Sep 15-22, Retro Cup Sep 22-29, Mega Color Cup Sep 29 - Oct 6, Mega Editions of all three leagues Oct 6-13, then Little Cup Oct 13-20
Season 24's remaining Community Days are Oct 10 (Zorua) and Nov 21; GO Pass: October has not been announced yet
just_past_window: Oct 31: Super Mega Raid Day, 2-5pm local

games.typical_lead_time: in-game events announced only 4-7 days ahead; DLC and update news months ahead

timeline.title: PokemonXP and Worlds Cloud Island
timeline.detail: Grab the mysterious goggles from any Pokemon Center in an area at environment level 3 or above and enter address JW7MXKP2 to tour the Worlds stage island; no end date has been announced.

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Chansey Plant
timeline.detail: Enter code P0K0P1AGARDENS at any Pokemon Center PC (Mystery Gift, code entry) for a placeable Chansey Plant; codes are region free and valid through Oct 7.

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Ditto Rug
timeline.detail: Claim the Ditto Rug at any Pokemon Center PC via the internet Mystery Gift option, no code needed; available through Jan 31, 2027.

timeline.title: Expansion Pass: Part 1 out now
timeline.detail: Part 1, Bubbly Basin, is live on the eShop and needs the Bleak Beach environment request plus the new Dive move; buying the pass before Aug 31, 2027 also emails a code for 30 rare Pokemetal ingots, valid through Sep 30, 2027.

just_past_window: No in-game event is running or announced right now; the last one, Fetching Scales for Feebas, ended Aug 28
Expansion Pass Part 2 arrives in late 2026 with accessories, new furniture and Pokemon but no new town; Part 3 and its new town follow in 2027

games.typical_lead_time: official news posts land 1-2 weeks ahead; launch dates confirmed by Pawprint

timeline.title: Global launch on PC and consoles
timeline.detail: Aniimo goes free-to-play on PS5, Xbox Series X and S, PC and Xbox cloud gaming; the America server opens Sep 15 at 10:00 p.m. EDT, and pre-download is open now with a 40 GB PC install recommended on an SSD.

timeline.title: Carry over your beta rewards
timeline.detail: Log in with the same email you used in the betas, entered manually with a verification code rather than a Google sign-in, or link it in Account Center before creating a character; a skipped first-time link can only be fixed through Customer Support.

timeline.title: Mobile launch
timeline.detail: iOS and Android follow on Sep 23 on the same global servers; the one-time email-link prompt at first mobile login is the only chance to attach an existing Aniimo Pass to a third-party sign-in.
